basic_info.description: Major Price Improvement! Don't miss this incredible opportunity to own a TRIPLEX in the highly desirable Richmond District of San Francisco! Situated in a tranquil neighborhood with easy access to both nature and cultural attractions, this property represents a prime investment opportunity. Act now and make this exceptional triplex yours!
